title: Add a game · Complete the form

marks.label: Click Add game to open the new-game form on the right.
Enter the game name and English name. The names shown here are examples.
Set Mod folder to the deployment folder that your loader actually reads.
Check the paths, then click Confirm to save the game configuration.

title: Activate a game · Check the current environment

marks.label: Double-click a game card to activate it. Double-click the active game again to deactivate it.
Current environment and the Current badge identify the active game.
Check the loader folder and Mod deployment folder before enabling a Mod.

title: Category Overview · Find categories and common actions

marks.label: Double-click a category card, such as 外观 (Appearance), to enter it before importing Mods.
The breadcrumb shows your current location. Click All to return to the category root.
Search by name, author or tag, and narrow the results with tag and type filters.
Use the preset selector to manage the current game's complete Mod loadout.

title: Inspect a Mod · Information, state and actions

marks.label: Check the Mod name, enabled state and selected variant at the top of its details.
Switch between Information, Keys and Variants to inspect each part of the Mod.
Click Edit to change the name, author, tags and description.
An enabled Mod shows Disable. Disabling it keeps the original in your library.

title: Import Mods · Choose sources and confirm

marks.label: Use Add Files or Add Folder to select one or more sources.
Review each item's age rating and preview. The destination is the category you opened before importing.
Click Confirm Import, then follow progress in the task center at the lower right.

title: Mod keys · Record or edit a binding

marks.label: Select a Mod and open Keys. These bindings belong to the Mod's INI files.
Click the current key to record a new binding, or use the edit icon to type one.
Open the INI file when you need to inspect the surrounding configuration.

title: Variants · Save different looks for one Mod

marks.label: Select a Mod and open Variants.

marks.target: 保存当前状态为新变体
marks.label: Save the current supported appearance state as a new named variant.
Choose a saved look. The variant currently in use has a status marker.

title: Combination presets · Save and switch loadouts

marks.label: Create a new combination preset here.
Click Apply beside a preset to switch to its complete loadout.
Select a preset before renaming or copying it.

title: Edit a Mod · Update information and tags

marks.target: 同时重命名 Mod 文件或文件夹
marks.label: Clear this option to change only the display name. Selecting it also renames the disk item.
Add or adjust tags, and check the scope when changing a shared tag.
Click Save changes, or press Ctrl+Enter, to save your edits.

title: Category presets · Import or export a category tree

marks.label: Import a .d3dxcp file, then review the destination game and differences in the category tree.
Export the category structure and optional category images. Mod archives are not included.

title: General settings · Deletion and task concurrency

marks.label: Open Settings → General, then select a settings group on the left.
Choose permanent deletion or the Recycle Bin, and check the operation's scope before proceeding.
Start with Auto recommend if you are unsure, then adjust concurrency to suit your disk.
Choose a light, dark or system theme in the appearance card.
Choose your interface language from this list.
Open the language-pack folder to customize translations, then refresh the list.
Select an interface font and check that text and symbols display correctly.
